title: Hybrid quantum-classical attention for histopathology-based molecular profiling in data-limited cancers
summary: Molecular profiling from routine histopathology could expand access to precision oncology when sequencing is unavailable, tissue is limited, or training cohorts are small. We developed a hybrid quantum-classical strategy that replaces softmax attention in a transformer for histopathology-based gene expression prediction with a quantum-derived doubly stochastic matrix (QDSM).
